All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations redlined (6)**
- **LOL-CAP** (critical): Section 15 excludes consequential damages mutually but sets no monetary cap — unlimited direct-damages exposure both ways. Added the mutual greater-of 12 months' fees / USD 1M cap, broadened carve-outs (gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) and confirmed fees are not "damages".
- **IP** (critical): Garman owns the Modifications/Improvements built for us with only a narrow use licence back, and the Agreement is silent on ownership of our data. Added a data-ownership sentence and a perpetual, royalty-free licence to Improvements/Modifications.
- **ASSIGN** (high): blanket mutual assignment bar with no affiliate/M&A carve-out. Added the carve-out, a reasonableness standard and a no-change-of-control-termination confirmation.
- **NOSOLICIT** (medium): mutual *no-hire* over all employees. Narrowed to a 12-month non-solicit of involved personnel with advertising/unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
- **INSURANCE** (missing): no insurance covenant despite on-site work and data handling. Inserted Section 20(k).
- **TRANSITION** (missing): one-way exit obligations, no data return or migration help. Inserted Section 17(d).
- **GOVLAW** (medium, low heat): Nova Scotia law/non-exclusive venue is off our accepted list; proposed New York, will take any accepted forum.

**Compliant (11)**: INDEMN (Garman IP indemnity, carved out of Section 15 — at fallback), T4C (90-day customer-only convenience right — fallback), RENEWAL (no auto-renewal), LICENSE (affiliates covered, perpetual while fees paid), WARRANTY (12-month conformance warranty with repair/refund remedies), AUDIT, LD, MINCOMMIT, NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN (all absent or in our favour). Note: Schedules A–F were not provided; we will confirm no MFN, minimum-commitment or price-uplift terms sit in the Fee Schedule.
